idea: ALM-I-022: make checkout intent creation idempotent and recoverable
object: authenticated profile + purchasable offer → reusable Stripe customer linkage → idempotent checkout session → bounded redirect/recovery state (web/src/lib/actions/billing.ts::startCheckout)

authority.profiles_link: service-role profiles.stripe_customer_id update; affected row verified before any session request
authority.entitlements: webhook reconciliation (W013 stripe-reconciliation.ts + reconcile_stripe_subscription) remains authoritative after payment; checkout never writes profiles.plan
authority.dashboard: existing /dashboard?billing=success|cancelled|unconfigured|error query vocabulary is the only redirect/recovery surface

idempotency.determinism: same profile+plan+offer version yields the same bounded non-secret customer/session keys

call_matrix.first_creation: customer_calls=1 link_calls=1 session_calls=1 (customer key on customer create, session key on session create)
call_matrix.duplicate_retry: identical session idempotency key across retries; customer key identical after interrupted first attempt; at most one logical customer and one logical checkout session at the adapter boundary
call_matrix.profile_link_failure: update error/no affected row/link throw → session_calls=0, bounded error recovery
call_matrix.invalid_cases: missing stripe/price/unsupported plan/admin unconfigured → provider_calls=0, bounded unconfigured recovery
call_matrix.provider_failures: customer/session throw or missing session URL → bounded error recovery, never success

write_invariant: service-role profiles update writes only stripe_customer_id (never plan/subscription_status); affected-row verification before any checkout session; no billing store, no client plan authority, no alternate provider, no extra intake step
w013_authority: W013 webhook/reconciliation remains authoritative after payment; checkout intent does not repair or duplicate it
fixture_note: Recording fixtures prove adapter call shape and fail-closed behavior only; they do not prove live Stripe replay, payment success, conversion, database isolation, or willingness to pay.
